'Target attack action card with Herald in its name gets +3{d}.'

'WITH HERALD IN ITS NAME' IS A SUBSTRING. CARD_IS_NAMED compared whole names (colour suffix stripped, so one entry covers all three printings) and no card is called 'Herald', so the filter matched nothing -- which is indistinguishable from a board with no legal target. `name_contains` is a separate key so a card that names ONE specific card cannot start matching a family that shares a word; ATTACK_NAME_IN gained the same key for the attacking side.

zone DEFENDING is where a {d} buff can land: +3{d} on an attack action card matters when it DEFENDS, and MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE moves the defending total. The two CARD_IS_TYPE clauses are the 'attack action card' half -- type Action AND subtype Attack; either alone is a different set, since an Attack Reaction is not an attack action card.

The target spec deliberately omits `amount: 1`, which is its default. The number is redundant, and a JSON number the printed text does not contain is what stops the colour variants being derived: the copier requires every number in the abilities to appear in the text, because otherwise it cannot establish which occurrence the text's number corresponds to.
